source_name: NSE — Nairobi Securities Exchange (listed companies + financials)
rate_limits: public site; some real-time market-data products are paid (pricelist)
notes: OPEN listed-company source. nse.co.ke/listed-companies/ publishes the listed-company directory (name, sector/segment). Verified live: Absa Bank Kenya PLC, Stanbic Holdings Plc, Standard Chartered Bank Ltd, Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Ltd, Sasini Ltd, Williamson Tea Kenya Ltd, Car and General (K) Ltd, Kapchorua/Limuru/Eaagads. Also listed-company announcements + financial results + market statistics; /wp-json/ reachable. Listed companies only (~60). Real-time market data has a paid pricelist.

source_name: BRS — Business Registration Service (company search + documents via eCitizen)
organization: Business Registration Service (Office of the Registrar of Companies)
rate_limits: per-transaction search + document fee (KES); eCitizen login; returned 403 to automation; no open bulk/API
notes: Official registrar (companies, business names, etc.). Search + documents (CR12 = directors & shareholders, status report, certified extract, annual returns) via the eCitizen platform — login-gated and paid per transaction. brs.ecitizen.go.ke returned 403 to automation. No open bulk/API. Directors/shareholders = personal data (Data Protection Act 2019). Field model from public knowledge; no values copied.

source_name: Kenya Open Data (KODI) — national open-data portal
notes: Kenya Open Data Initiative portal — reachable (HTTP 200) but a small landing page; standard CKAN/DKAN/Socrata catalog APIs returned 404. No accessible company-register dataset confirmed. Historically hosts statistics, not the company register.
